text: The World Federation of Engineering Organizations (WFEO), known in French as Federation Mondiale des Organisations d'Ingenieurs, is an international, non-governmental organization that represents the engineering profession globally. Established in 1968 by a group of regional engineering organizations under the auspices of UNESCO in Paris, WFEO is a non-governmental international organization comprising national engineering organizations from over 90 nations and representing approximately 20 million engineers worldwide. As part of the United Nations system, WFEO holds official NGO status with UNESCO (associate status) since its founding and participates in the work of key UN bodies, including the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) and its specialized agencies such as the United Nations Industrial Development Organization and the United Nations Environment Programme. At ECOSOC, WFEO co-organizes with the International Science Council the Scientific and Technological Community Major Group. In 2019, following a proposal by WFEO, UNESCO's General Conference approved the establishment of the UNESCO World Engineering Day for Sustainable Development, observed annually on 4 March. Since then, WFEO has coordinated global celebrations through its membership and partner institutions. The governing body of WFEO is the General Assembly, which between its meetings is guided by the Executive Council, with day-to-day business managed by the Executive Board, supported by the Executive Director. Decisions by the General Assembly, Executive Council, or Executive Board are made by majority vote. WFEO's membership includes 100 member institutions, consisting of national members representing individual countries and international members representing regions, continents, or global branches of engineering. The federation's specialized activities in engineering fields are conducted through its committees, which are hosted by national members for a four-year term. WFEO holds annual meetings for the General Assembly, Executive Council, and committees, typically in November, accompanied by a conference open to non-affiliated engineers. The President of WFEO is elected by the General Assembly for a two-year term, following an immediate past president/president/president-elect rotation system.
